known: Nile and Euphrates development-gauge hydrographs and timing spectra were inspected in the previous preflight. Terrain-only candidate areas are already exposed: Nile about24554km2 and LowerMesopotamia64004km2. Egypt baseline capacity2.32M and Mesopotamian overproduction are known. No new field climate extraction, storage simulation or ET-coverage outputs inspected.
purpose: Connect the conserved river ledger to finite field storage and crop demand, using a fixed calendar. Identify necessary storage/flow dependencies before any new irrigation-area or population calibration. This is development feasibility, not independent validation.

nile.gauge_context: Aswan upstream of tested valley; shared downstream pool is an optimistic connectivity bound, not a canal network

mesopotamia_euphrates_only.gauge_context: Euphrates contribution only; Tigris is absent, so this is not a total Mesopotamian water budget

terrain: Reuse existing groundwork algorithm exactly: ETOPO60arcsec landz>0, nearest NaturalEarth navigable river scalerank<=4, HAND<=5m and distance<=30km,1degreepad, latitude-mean distance metric perbox. Select those1arcmin cells without changing thresholds. Use actualrowlat cellarea for volume; report difference from earlier constant-area summary. NegativeHAND retained as in groundwork; this candidate mask does not prove flood accessibility or drainage.
climate: WorldClim2.1 5arcmin monthly Tavg,prec,Tmax,Tmin at each candidatecell's containing5minpixel. PET via existing Hargreaves/sunlight_top functions. Modern climate and earlier gauges are noncontemporaneous; do not infer ancient flow or exact yields.
crop_calendar: November start(index10),5monthlybins for BOTHregions and BOTHbarley/wheat. Existing CROPS temperature window,need_warm,heat/base andDAYS determine eligibility; no alternative season chosen when ineligible. CropET=kc*PET during fixedcrop only. No cropoptimiser or fullywatered tie selection.
river_source: Use committed qualified mean monthly gauge discharges. Positive excess max(q-mean(q),0) times365/12days*86400 gives captureable m3/bin. This is a declared highflow availability scenario, not a measured divertible share. Never substitute timing fractions for volumes. Fullabove-mean source is passed once to a single basin node; leftover water exits thatnode. NoTigris input or generated fantasy runoff assumed.

storage_sweep.selection: Retain all96region/crop/storage/loss/capture combinations with equal status; no best member selected or adopted. Storage and bareET are explicit uncalibrated sensitivity bounds.

monthly_operator: Startstock+effective_rain(0.8P),spill above capacity; during Aug/Sep/Oct request remaining field capacity at river. Aggregate useful requests in m3; subtract gross withdrawal/loss through route_water_budget; share delivered volume proportionally to eachfield request at sharednode,with no perfield reuse of totalriverwater. Adddelivered, then meet cropET or bareET from stored water,carry only remaining storage to nextmonth. Allrainincluding excluded0.2P,spill,delivery losses,ET,outlet andstockchange accounted separately. No groundwater or returnflow.
periodicity: Start allfields atzero. Repeat supplied climatologicalyear until endstock equals startstock within1e-6mm for EVERYfield,atmost50years. If unsupported/nonconverged,report explicitly and do not score ETcoverage. No free initialwater; report finalannual start/endstocks and allmonthly fluxes.
outputs: All rows and paired no-capture controls. Candidate and eligiblearea, cropETcoverage and area at>=95%potentialcropET, source/withdrawal/delivery/loss/outlet volumes, local rain/ET/spill and monthlystocks. >=95%ET is a wateradequacy diagnostic,not validated cropyield,irrigationarea or residentcapacity. NPZ/fullfield CSV,source/code hashes,plots andreport.
review: Synthetic controls before fieldresults; independent scalar fieldstorage/aggregation and river/soil monthly massclosure; no-flow/no-free-stock/capacity/phase/rotation controls. Independently reconstruct eligibility,fieldareas and sourcevolumes from committedinputs. Freshbyte replay of numericfiles; normalpage/download/browserchecks. Preserve all904Earthfitassets/defaults.
heldout: None qualified. Indus pre1932 remainsUNSCORED. Bothregions are development diagnostics; a passing waterledger cannot repair an independent transfer gate.
